Built around tender navy beans, chopped sweet carrots, crisp celery, and sweet yellow onions, this vibrant dish receives a luscious boost from generous amounts of extra virgin olive oil added toward the end of cooking. Designed specifically as a convenient make-ahead meal, the aromatic vegetable broth and creamy white beans continue to absorb flavor while chilling in the refrigerator overnight. Reheating gentle simmered broth actually deepens the savory garlic and tomato background notes, producing a thicker and more harmonious texture on the second day. Fresh oregano and a bright finish of squeezed lemon juice balance the hearty beans, making this colorful soup satisfying yet surprisingly light. Pair this wholesome soup with crusty sourdough bread, salty feta cheese, and kalamata olives for a complete rustic tavern experience right at your home dining parsley, then cool before storing to develop flavor."}]}]},{"title":"Vietnamese Lemongrass Pork Skewers in Pot","readyInMinutes":40,"servings":4,"summary":"These fragrant Vietnamese skewers offer a clever one-pot adaptation of street food style minced pork skewers packed with vibrant aromatics. Juicy ground pork is seasoned with finely minced lemongrass, crushed garlic, shallots, fish sauce, and a touch of brown sugar before being molded tightly around bamboo sticks. Instead of setting up an outdoor grill, these skewers are expertly seared directly inside a single heavy Dutch oven on the stovetop. Searing the meat in a hot pot yields a beautifully caramelized exterior while trapping all natural juices within the pot for a quick pan glaze. A splash of coconut water drizzled along the bottom of the pot creates a light steaming effect, ensuring the interior remains extraordinarily tender while building a rich savory coating. Served alongside fresh cucumber slices, pickled carrots, and warm rice noodles, this streamlined recipe delivers authentic Southeast Asian barbecue flavor with minimal cleanup
